item.title: Fire Apparatus of the Day: Feb. 13, 2026
item.description: A 1,500-gpm pump and 500-gallon tank are on board this 78-foot aerial ladder quint built by E-ONE for the Sharonville (OH) Fire Department. item.title: Lisbon Village (OH) Approves Purchasing 2023 Pumper
item.description: The Lisbon Village, Ohio, Council approved the purchase of a 2023 fire apparatus for $500,000, to be funded by the fire levy, with service expected in four to six weeks. item.description: The Geneva (NY) Fire Department has been awarded $1 million to replace a 2006 engine that has exceeded its service life. item.title: Petaluma (CA)’s Aging Fire Station 1 Slated for $8.7M Renovation
item.description: Petaluma, California's downtown fire station will undergo renovations starting this winter, including seismic upgrades, hazardous material abatement, and improved accessibility, with completion expected by early 2027. item.title: FAMA Forum: Supporting and Advancing the Industry
item.description: Jason Witmier, the new FAMA president for 2026, emphasizes the importance of teamwork and gradual change in the fire apparatus industry, highlighting challenges in navigating information and opinions. item.title: Plainfield Township (MI) FD Welcomes New Engine
item.description: The new Engine 3 has a 1,750-gallon-per-minute (gpm) pump and a 500-gallon water tank. It's also equipped to respond to vehicle crashes, medical emergencies, and smaller-scale hazardous materials incidents. The post Plainfield Township (MI) FD Welcomes New Engine appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: CA Fire Apparatus Crashes En Route to Separate Collision
item.description: A Sonoma County fire engine crashed while responding to another collision in Windsor. Two people in a Prius were hospitalized; no firefighters were injured. The incident is under investigation. The post CA Fire Apparatus Crashes En Route to Separate Collision appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: City Apparatus Taken from Yantic (CT) Engine Company Back in Service
item.description: Norwich's Yantic Fire Engine Co. No. 1 was shut down for non-compliance with a new unified command policy, leading to repossession of firetrucks. City officials assert the policy enhances public safety. The post City Apparatus Taken from Yantic (CT) Engine Company Back in Service appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: Morgan (AL) County Commission Districts Donating $40,000 to Somerville Volunteer Fire Dept.
item.description: The Morgan County Commission is donating $40,000 for repairs to the Somerville Volunteer Fire Department's parking lot, funded from road and bridge funds to expedite necessary improvements.
